prompt_text: Who is the best HVAC company in Houston for AC repair?
answer_verbatim:
"Best" depends on your needs (speed, price, warranty, brand experience, residential vs commercial). I can narrow it down if you tell me your ZIP code and whether this is an emergency or a routine repair. Meanwhile, here’s a practical approach and a few well-regarded options to consider in Houston:

Quick shortlist (widely recommended/available in Houston)
- John Moore Services — Houston-based, full-service home HVAC company with strong local reputation.
- ARS/Rescue Rooter (ARS) — national chain with local Houston branches; lots of availability and emergency service.
- One Hour Heating & Air Conditioning / Benjamin Franklin — national brands that operate locally and often offer on-time guarantees.

How to pick the best company for your situation
1. License & insurance — verify they’re licensed by the Texas Department of Licensing and Regulation (TDLR) and carry liability insurance.
2. Certifications — look for NATE-certified technicians and manufacturer training for your AC brand.
3. Reviews & complaints — check Google, Yelp, Nextdoor and the BBB for recent customer experiences.
4. Written estimate — get at least 2–3 estimates that break down parts, labor, taxes, permits and disposal fees.
5. Warranties & parts — ask about labor and part warranties and whether they use OEM or aftermarket parts.
6. Response & availability — if it’s urgent, confirm emergency/after-hours service and expected arrival time.
7. Price transparency — watch for diagnostic or trip fees and ask whether the diagnostic fee is waived if you hire them.
8. References — ask for recent local references or examples of similar repairs.

If you want, tell me your ZIP code and whether this is an emergency. I’ll pull 3–5 top-rated HVAC companies near you (with ratings and contact guidance) so you can call the best fit.
